changelog:
- Initial release of the program-derivation skill.
- Provides step-by-step guidance for architecture analysis, formal program derivation, abstraction layer design, and software metrics (CC, LCOM, coupling, cohesion, lock-in).
- Output structure and terminology available in both German and English.
- Includes detailed work instructions, example tables, interface definitions in TypeScript/Python/Java, and reference checklists.
- Supports triggered use cases like architecture analysis, interface design, complexity measurement, refactoring planning, and quality assessment.
summary: Führt Architekturanalyse, Komplexitätsmessung, Abstraktionsschicht-Design, Vendor Lock-in Bewertung, Refactoring-Planung und Software-Qualitätsbewertung durch.
